store.name: Juniper Thread Co.
store.tagline: Small-batch apparel, cut and sewn by hand.
store.sandbox_notice: Sandbox demo data. Juniper Thread Co. is a fictional store.

skus.name: Indigo Chore Jacket
skus.description: Unlined chore jacket in 10 oz indigo-dyed cotton twill. Three patch pockets, corozo buttons, boxy fit. Hand wash cold; color will fade with wear.

skus.name: Hand-Stitched Canvas Tote
skus.description: Natural 12 oz canvas tote with hand-stitched leather handles and one interior pocket. 15 x 16 x 5 in.

skus.name: Waffle-Knit Henley
skus.description: Long-sleeve three-button henley in cotton waffle knit. Relaxed fit; pre-washed to limit shrinkage.

skus.name: Selvedge Straight Jeans
skus.description: 13.5 oz raw selvedge denim, mid rise, straight leg. Unwashed; expect up to 1 in. of length shrinkage after first wash.

skus.name: Merino Rib Beanie
skus.description: Double-layer 2x2 rib beanie in 100% merino wool. One size.

skus.name: Block-Print Bandana
skus.description: 22 x 22 in. cotton bandana, hand block-printed with plant-based ink. Each print varies slightly.

skus.name: Brushed Flannel Overshirt
skus.description: Heavyweight brushed cotton flannel overshirt in a forest plaid. Two chest pockets, regular fit.

skus.name: Garment-Dyed Crew Tee
skus.description: Midweight cotton crew tee, garment-dyed in small batches. Shade varies batch to batch; shown in Clay.

skus.name: Corduroy Work Pants
skus.description: 8-wale cotton corduroy work pants with a relaxed taper and gusseted crotch.

skus.name: Quilted Liner Vest
skus.description: Diamond-quilted nylon vest with recycled polyester fill and snap front. Layers under the chore jacket.

skus.name: Linen Camp Shirt
skus.description: Short-sleeve camp-collar shirt in washed European linen. Boxy fit.

skus.name: Hemp Market Apron
skus.description: Full-length hemp canvas apron with cross-back straps and a divided front pocket.

skus.name: Wool Blend Scarf
skus.description: 70% wool / 30% nylon herringbone scarf, 72 x 12 in., fringed ends.

skus.name: Linen Wrap Dress
skus.description: Midi-length wrap dress in washed linen with a self-tie waist and flutter sleeves. Shown in Sage. Cut to our size chart v1; linen relaxes slightly with wear.

skus.name: Smocked Midi Skirt
skus.description: Cotton poplin midi skirt with a fully smocked elastic waist and side pockets.

skus.name: Ribbed Tank
skus.description: Fitted 1x1 rib tank in organic cotton with a touch of elastane.

skus.name: Patchwork Quilt Throw
skus.description: 50 x 60 in. throw pieced from our cutting-room offcuts and hand-quilted. Every throw is one of a kind.

skus.name: Waxed Canvas Bucket Hat
skus.description: Paraffin-waxed cotton canvas bucket hat with a cotton lining. S/M and L/XL.

skus.name: Chunky Knit Cardigan
skus.description: Hand-finished chunky knit cardigan in a wool-alpaca blend with horn buttons. Oversized fit.

skus.name: Cotton Gauze Pajama Set
skus.description: Double-layer cotton gauze pajama shirt and drawstring pant.
